name: SingleAPI
title: singleapi.co
payoff: Convert websites to API in seconds
shortDescription: SingleAPI allows users to transform any website into a usable API instantly, leveraging GPT-4 technology to navigate and extract data as JSON. This tool is ideal for developers, researchers, and businesses looking to automate data extraction and integration. Example use case: A developer uses SingleAPI to scrape product data from e-commerce sites to monitor pricing changes automatically.
pros: Easy to use with powerful capabilities
Supports a wide range of use cases
Includes features like proxy rotation and API diagnostics
cons: Limited free tier with only 100 requests
Custom pricing may be expensive for high volume users
Dependent on external websites' structure and availability
